title: Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses: UK Alumni
description: Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses is an investment to help entrepreneurs create jobs and economic opportunity by providing greater access to education and business support services. The programme has reached over 1,700 businesses from across the UK and has resulted in immediate and sustained business growth for the alumni of the programme. Meet our alumni: https://www.goldmansachs.com/citizenship/10000-small-businesses/UK/profiles/index.html

asr.full_text: I had no idea what I was doing. I didn't know how to take the business to the next level. If we were going to continue to grow, I was going to need some help. Looking back, I wish I'd gone onto this program a lot earlier. I think we could have been further. Down the road. There was a huge amount of knowledge and expertise. The impact on our. Business has been exponential. The course was littered with life-altering moments. It was like the shutters came out on the business. It's been a phenomenal course. I. Was so pumped when we came away from it. What it taught me is that it's so. Important to hone your skills and to invest in you as an entrepreneur. Not. Only has it changed what I do day to day, I'm just focusing on where we're going. Next and how I'm gonna get there. The emotions have been up and down. I'm. Finally on a high. The whole team really believe in the vision. It changed my. Business. It changed me really. It lets you understand your purpose better. It. Makes you figure out your direction of travel. We're 22 years in but we're just. Getting started. We really are.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a Goldman Sachs UK alumni feature about the 10,000 Small Businesses programme, with the speaker discussing education, business development, and personal growth. The described material does not present a financial-return or payment-based opportunity or request money, credentials, or investment participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The main content is an alumni feature promoting an ordinary education and business-support service through a course testimonial.
